# ARUP Laboratories

> ARUP Laboratories is a comprehensive reference laboratory providing diagnostic testing services spanning clinical pathology, genetics, hematopathology, and infectious disease with advanced molecular diagnostics capabilities.

ARUP Laboratories offers a full spectrum of laboratory testing services including genetic sequencing, molecular diagnostics, and specialized pathology testing. The site provides extensive resources for healthcare providers including specimen handling guidelines, billing codes, turnaround times, and clinical consultation services.

## Core Laboratory Services

- [ARUP Laboratories](https://www.aruplab.com): ARUP Laboratories homepage with diagnostic testing and laboratory services
- [ARUP Lab Test Directory](https://ltd.aruplab.com): ARUP Lab Test Directory with comprehensive test menu and laboratory services
- [Testing Specialties](https://www.aruplab.com/testing/specialties): ARUP testing specialties including pathology, chemistry, and genetics divisions
- [Genetics](https://www.aruplab.com/genetics): ARUP genetics testing including whole genome sequencing and hereditary cancer
- [Hematopathology](https://www.aruplab.com/hematopathology): ARUP hematopathology testing for blood disorders using FISH and flow cytometry
- [Infectious Disease](https://www.aruplab.com/infectious-disease): ARUP infectious disease testing including virology, microbiology, and parasitology
- [Antineural Antibody Testing](https://www.aruplab.com/antineural-antibody-testing-autoimmune-neurologic-disease): Antineural antibody testing for autoimmune neurologic disease diagnosis and panels

## Testing Resources & Guidelines

- [Resources](https://www.aruplab.com/testing/resources): Testing resources including specimen preparation and billing code information
- [Specimen Information](https://www.aruplab.com/testing/resources/specimen): Specimen collection, handling, and transport guidelines for laboratory testing
- [Turnaround Time](https://www.aruplab.com/testing/resources/turnaround-time): STAT testing procedures and turnaround time information for laboratory services
- [Critical and Alert Values](https://www.aruplab.com/testing/resources/values): Critical and alert values definitions and clinical notification procedures

## Billing & Coding Reference

- [CPT Code Updates](https://www.aruplab.com/testing/cpt): CPT code updates and biweekly/annual test code changes from AMA
- [LOINC Codes](https://www.aruplab.com/testing/resources/loinc_codes): LOINC code reference for laboratory test identification and healthcare interoperability
- [Palmetto Z-Codes](https://www.aruplab.com/testing/resources/codes): DEX Z-Code reference for molecular diagnostic test identification and policies
- [Performed/Reported Schedule Updates](https://ltd.aruplab.com/updates/performed-reported-updates): Test schedule updates and turnaround time changes for diagnostic testing
